Every other completed job of that run succeeded, including verify (macos-latest) job 131644388009 and security / osv-scanner. `node --test tests/harness/mutation-evidence.test.mjs tests/harness/mutation-red-baseline.test.mjs tests/harness/mutation-evidence-gate.test.mjs` -> tests 12, pass 12, fail 0. `npx vitest run` over the five svg-witness-cleanup/process files in packages/cli -> 'Test Files 5 passed (5)', 'Tests 24 passed (24)'. findings.summary: M18.10's mutation evidence was valid for one commit. f996d15 recorded nightly 43195429912 at 361b9f2. Two hours later, 9ec6eef changed pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml, and mutation-evidence-provenance treats every non-bookkeeping path after the evidence revision as a mutation input, so the gate's first red leg is the mutation evidence again. It needs a new full nightly (about 14 h) at or after the last code commit. ci-evidence and nightly perf need the same floor. Neither 9ec6eef's body nor any record says the evidence went stale. blockedReason still says 'M18.10 is done' and 'Rows left: M18.43's closeout'. Code rows are still to come: M18.288 (stream 2's render patch, ready), a fix for the cold-setup red (F2), and any osv advisory. No record says that the evidence nightly must come after all of them, or how landing is held until it is recorded.

findings.summary: f996d15 found that nightly 43195429912's perf job failed NFR-PERF-002 at 1025 ms against 1000. It handled this in prose ('handed to stream 1 for a row'), with no backlog row on main and no blockedReason clause. Nightly perf is an M18 completion leg ('three-OS CI and nightly perf cover final review range'). The row stream 2 has drafted, M18.288 in e491a15 (not on main), is marked done on local timings only. Its own figures leave the leg near a coin flip on CI. This is the cp49 lesson again: evidence for a remote run did not allow for the remote runner's speed.

questions.coherence: Coherent. The M18.10 thread now forms one chain. The red baseline got its output printed (M18.286). Its cause was read from Huy's download and fixed at its source (M18.287 extends the existing Windows rule to POSIX, which keeps one owned-termination path). The cut receipt was compacted, the compact form is digest-validated against the plan, and an over-long notice is refused, so evidence is never lost silently. M18.287's decision is logged with time, agent and delegation, and its ADR amendment is in the same commit. Two seams: the perf red left the M18.10 close as prose rather than a row (F3), and the dependency fix that main's red required silently re-opened the mutation leg (F1).

questions.gateHonesty: No gate was weakened. thresholds.mjs, the mutation floors and COLD_SETUP_MAX_MS are unchanged. The receipt change makes validation stricter, not looser: count and sha256 are recomputed from the plan, the job check reads ids from the plan, and schemaVersion 1 is refused. The completion gate cannot pass: 62/76, with mutation evidence red because of 9ec6eef. That is correct behaviour, and provenance should not be narrowed to pass it. Imagined mutants: (1) validateReceipt skipping the count comparison is caught by the 'r.partitions.count = 2' case. (2) redTestLines taking slice(0, 200) instead of slice(-200) is caught by the long-failure case, which expects 'line 51' first. (3) svg-witness-cleanup giving a POSIX kill that throws the 2 s Windows window is caught by the posix case expecting a verdict at exactly 3 s, not 5 s. All three suites ran green here (12/12 harness, 24/24 vitest). The gap is in the closing sequence, not in the gates: perf and browser evidence can each come from a different tree unless the closeout pins one freeze sha (F1, F5).
questions.architecture: Clean. No pure-core package changed. M18.287 is CLI-internal: createWitnessCleanup keeps its signature, and there is no public API growth. The receipt schemaVersion 2 is a harness format, not a product contract. 9ec6eef adds no dependency: overrides of transitive dev and runtime deps (hono via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk in @fluxion/mcp, basic-ftp via @lhci/cli), all MIT and past minimumReleaseAge, with no osv excusal. The license job is green in 43351801498. The next free ADR is still 0218.

Learned: "cp50 (through `9ec6eef`): M18.10 closed on a clean nightly after its red baseline was diagnosed and its cut receipt compacted. But the evidence held for one commit: a forced dependency fix made it stale two hours later, and the next run's cold setup went 4 s over. When the final evidence takes a 14-hour run and binds to the last code commit, the closeout needs a declared code freeze. Every known code row lands first, and a mark, not prose, holds the freeze."
